newsitem.title: UK: Telspec squeezed higher in sparse trading.
newsitem.headline: Telspec squeezed higher in sparse trading.

text.p: Telspec Plc shares spurted ahead on Thursday when meagre buying in a tight market squeezed the price higher, dealers said.
Shares in the telecommunications equipment group put on 42-1/2p to 267-1/2p by 1340 GMT, making it the biggest gainer in London.
"It's the nature of the stock. It's just been squeezed up 10p and then people see that and think 'I'll have a bit of that myself'. That's all," said one.
The shares leapt at the end of last month, when, despite reporting heavy losses in 1996, the company said it expected to return to profitability this year.
Telspec was listed in December 1993 and its shares set a record 10.50 stg high in November 1995, before tumbling last May on a first-half profit warning.
Last September it said the difficulties had been "significantly worse" than it had first expected and the shares hit a low of 130p at the end of 1996. -- Louise Ireland +44 171 542 4026
